scope: Fit each competition in configs/analysis-scope.json separately. Use the R5 match calendar and original R7 controls for the main and recent periods. Independently fit the six R10 2015/16 to 2018/19 panels using their original training, validation and test roles. These historical evaluation windows were reported previously. This model has not been evaluated on them at registration.
history: For each team use only dates strictly before the target date in the same competition, indexed by the exact team identity used by R7. Read all games on a date before applying that date to history. The inputs are fixture dates and listed home/away roles. No goal label, injury, lineup, target odds change, future result or other-competition schedule enters the calendar features. Report the original panel and lookback coverage.
features: For each scoring side, in own/opponent order, use (1) max(0,7-days_since_last)/6 if any preceding appearance within 14 days, (2) min(1,max(0,appearances_in_last_14_days-2)/3), (3) min(1,listed_away_appearances_in_last_7_days/2). Windows include day minus 14 or 7 and exclude today. Unknown histories give zero. Listed-away observations measure calendar role, with no inference of travel. Count explicitly identified same-day fixtures in subsequent dates only.
fit: Pool the two sides of a fixture within a competition. Tilt the complete chronological anchor PMF by the sum, over home and away, of (scored_at_least_one * x dot scoring_beta) and (max(0,min(goals,4)-1) * x dot additional_beta). Twelve parameters per competition. Minimize regularized joint score negative log likelihood on the original training fold. Ridge is 24/2 times sum of squares, coefficient bounds [-1,1]. Use the original unfitted chronological R7 anchor to train and the frozen R7 distribution for validation, test and prospective use. No available density signal gives the exact underlying distribution. A no-calendar control is original R7; fixed full dose is a secondary sensitivity.
choice: On the original chronological validation fold choose mixture dose 0, 0.5 or 1 with the existing R10 choose function separately for score, WDL and total. For scores prioritize first hits, then top-three hits, then exact-score log loss, then smaller dose. Each zero-dose head inherits its original issued R7 selection, including any numerical ties. Target results cannot change these choices.
outputs: Report each competition and each window on the complete historical populations, four original KPI definitions and five settlement categories, same-fixture R7 and available market comparisons with date-cluster intervals, and counts of entries to and exits from the first and three-score sets. Within each competition and original source date rank the actual primary by its probability, then event ID, compare both rules on their respective firsts. Report filled seats, full and short batches, each ordered seat and all-three unique-first sweeps. Retain zero-size competitions. Historical rows without actual market lines have no total denominator.
forward: For forward predictions fit the same coefficients on the complete original R5 panel using the validation-selected doses. Start with the already registered 192 R7 first issues, reconstruct the precise frozen R5/R7 odds and local R7 prior. Select only entire competition/Beijing-date groups still unstarted when the R17 enrollment is frozen. Retain all started-group exclusions. Calendar context may add previous source dates of R7 fixtures in the same competition, originally signed before the enrollment, without reading their outcomes. Mark these schedule-only appearances separately. Exclude the entire target source date from history. Freeze all eligible firsts and ranked seats before the earliest included kickoff, with original control IDs.
interpretation: Separate the new historical study, the new prospective research batch and the original user-facing firsts. All four project stages and the 100 percent complete-batch first-score target apply to original user-facing windows under project-goals.json. Report gains and losses even when a candidate loses. Preserve Current, Test and comprehensive firsts.
